title: add RAG agent examples and docs site quickstart updates
author: Maya Patel
description: Adds a set of RAG agent examples (Python + TypeScript) and updates the docs site with a concise quickstart and new template pages. Motivation: make it easier for developers to get started with agent/tool-calling workflows using Redwood RAG patterns and provide canonical repo examples that mirror the docs quickstart. This PR includes: 1) example agents (playbooks) demonstrating tool-calling, structured output, and fallback behavior; 2) RAG templates for common patterns (faq-bot, ticket-triage, doc-summarizer); 3) docs site quickstart pages with step-by-step instructions and cURL/SDK snippets; 4) images/diagrams and minor layout tweaks for the quickstart landing page; 5) small CI tweak to ensure docs preview build runs against the new pages. Checklist: - [x] Add Python example agent with README and tests - [x] Add TypeScript example agent with README - [x] Docs quickstart page added and linked from main quickstarts TOC - [x] Images and diagrams added under site/static - [x] CI docs-preview step validated - [x] Reviewed and approved by docs & examples owners. Related: ENG-8452, PM-2130. No breaking changes.
release_notes: Add RAG agent example playbooks (Python + TypeScript) and docs site quickstart pages; includes RAG templates and images. No breaking changes.
